name: Sabana Grande (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Quartered green and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal coat of arms with a mural crown, reading PUEBLO DE LOS PRODIGIOS.
history: Sabana Grande is a town and municipality of Puerto Rico located north of Lajas and Guánica; south of Maricao; east of San Germán; and west of Yauco.

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown
